record.bible_text: The words<WH01697> of Agur<WH094> the son<WH01121> of Jakeh<WH03348>, <FI>even<Fi> the prophecy<WH04853>: the man<WH01397> spake<WH05002><WTH8803> unto Ithiel<WH0384>, even unto Ithiel<WH0384> and Ucal<WH0401>,
